description: Cover Art Archive images for a release or release-group MBID: front/back flags, image types, full-resolution URLs, and 250/500/1200px thumbnail URLs. Returns an empty image set (NOT an error) when the entity has no art — absence of art is information. An MBID that matches no release or release-group of the given entity_type fails with entity_not_found instead of an empty set. Art is served at the release level; a release-group MBID resolves to a representative release's art automatically. URLs are linked, never rehosted — image copyright stays with the rights holders (only MusicBrainz core metadata is CC0).

entity_type.description: Whether the MBID is a release (default) or a release-group.

name: musicbrainz_get_cover_art

entityType.description: Whether the MBID was treated as a release or release-group.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_mbid`: The MBID is malformed or the all-zeros sentinel — a value MusicBrainz rejects outright (HTTP 400). `entity_not_found`: The MBID is well-formed but no entity of the given entity_type exists with it (the archive returns 404 and the MusicBrainz check of the MBID returns 404). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasArt.description: Whether any cover art exists for this entity.

images.description: Cover-art images (empty when the entity has no art).

items.description: One cover-art image with its full URL and thumbnails.

approved.description: Whether the image is community-approved. Omitted when unknown.

back.description: Whether this is a designated back image.

comment.description: Editor comment on the image. Omitted when absent.

front.description: Whether this is a designated front image.

imageUrl.description: Full-resolution image URL (linked, not rehosted — copyright stays with the rights holder).

types.description: Image types (Front, Back, Booklet, Medium, …; may be empty).

notice.description: Present when the entity has no art: states that no images exist, or — when the MBID could not be checked against MusicBrainz — that its existence is unconfirmed.

representativeRelease.description: For a release-group query, the release MBID whose art was returned. Omitted for direct release queries.

title: musicbrainz-mcp-server: get cover art
